title: Sponsor The OpenStack Conference!
description: Archived sponsorship information for the San Francisco 2012 OpenStack Conference, with links to the event prospectus and sponsorship agreement.
body:
• Sponsorship Prospectus
  • Sponsorship Agreement

Having a presence at the OpenStack Conference is a great way to get your company in front of the OpenStack community. This time, there are four available levels of Sponsorship: Headline, Permiere, Event, and Startup.

Whichever level you choose to participate, you'll want to act quicklywe've already seen a lot of interest from potential sponsors.

Read over all the details for this event in the Sponsor Prospectus and, when you're ready, download and complete the Sponsorship Agreement. Signed agreements or additional questions concerning sponsorship can be sent to sponsors@openstack.org.
